solutions.title: Nested product scan
solutions.strategy: For each index, multiply every value at a different index.

timeComplexity.explanation: The outer loop chooses each output index and the inner loop scans the full array.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The result array stores one product per input element.

solutions.title: Prefix and suffix products
solutions.strategy: Store product of values before each index, then multiply by products after each index.

timeComplexity.explanation: Two linear passes build prefix and suffix contributions.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The output array is required; aside from it only scalar running products are stored.
